description: Generated zebra puzzle (5 houses × 3 attributes, 11 clues, unique solution verified by brute force).

input.message:
5 houses stand in a row, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right.
Each house has a different colour (red, green, blue, amber, violet), one resident (Ada, Bruno, Chen, Dara, Eli), and each resident drinks a different beverage (tea, coffee, milk, juice, water).

Clues:
1. Dara is in house 3.
2. the tea drinker is in the green house.
3. the juice drinker is in house 4.
4. the red house is home to Dara.
5. the amber house is in house 1.
6. the juice drinker is in the blue house.
7. the tea drinker is somewhere to the left of Ada.
8. Bruno lives in the amber house.
9. Dara drinks the water drinker.
10. Eli is in house 4.
11. the milk drinker is in house 5.

This puzzle has exactly one solution. Work out who lives in each house, its colour, and their drink.

End your answer with one line per house in EXACTLY this format:
House 1: <name> - <colour> - <drink>
House 2: <name> - <colour> - <drink>
(and so on)
